def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    borrowed_amount_jpy = 1_000_000
    borrowing_rate = 0.005
    investment_rate = 0.05
    exchange_rate = 0.05  # Brazilian Reals per Japanese Yen

    # Convert borrowed funds to BRL and calculate the interest-rate spread
    invested_amount_brl = borrowed_amount_jpy * exchange_rate
    investment_interest_brl = invested_amount_brl * investment_rate
    borrowing_interest_brl = (
        borrowed_amount_jpy * borrowing_rate * exchange_rate
    )
    profit_brl = investment_interest_brl - borrowing_interest_brl

    # Return the profit to the nearest integer
    return round(profit_brl)
